snippet.title: World War Z VR - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The swarms are back for more in World War Z VR! 🧟🥽 Featuring a unique single-player experience based in the universe of World War Z.

Feel the gore and immersive chaos like never before with:
🧟 Hordes in VR
💪 7 Playable Characters
🌐 3 Vast Environments
💀 3 Difficulty Options
🔫 Weapons & Perks Systems

Prepare your headsets to outlive the dead on August 12!

Pre-order now to receive the Golden Skin Pack bonus! ✅
🩸 Meta Quest - https://www.meta.com/experiences/world-war-z-vr/5323873594311530/
🩸 Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362660/World_War_Z_VR/
